slides.quote: Rest first. *Then let yourself want things.*

captions.instagram:
Rest first. Then let yourself want things.

A tired body isn’t a broken one. Sleep, slow down, put the week down. Then, when you’re ready, let yourself want, without apologising for it. Tag someone who needs this tonight.

#Intimova #SelfLove #PleasureIsSelfCare #NoShame #Wellbeing
